meta.name: configuration-secrets-convention
meta.description: Establish config loading hierarchy, startup validation, and secrets handling with no secrets committed to repository. Use for secure environment portability.

copy.tagline: 安全加载配置并防止密钥泄露
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在不同环境安全传递配置和密钥
copy.tagline_en: Load config securely and prevent secret leaks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to securely pass configs and secrets across environments

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会按照默认、环境、本地覆盖的层级加载配置，并在启动时验证必要设置是否缺失。它还会确保敏感信息（如密码）不提交到代码仓库，而是通过环境变量或 .env.example 文件管理。
howto.when: 当需要处理配置文件、环境变量或密钥时触发，例如设置新项目、部署或重构配置相关代码。

say.text: 帮我设置配置层级：默认、环境、本地覆盖。
say.note: Claude 会生成对应的配置文件结构。

say.text: 检查我的 .env.example 是否安全，不包含真实密钥。
say.note: Claude 会审查文件并给出修改建议。

say.text: 添加启动验证，确保所有必需配置都存在。
say.note: Claude 会添加验证逻辑，缺失时快速失败。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude loads configuration in a hierarchy: default, environment, local override. It validates required settings at startup and ensures secrets are not committed to the repository, using environment variables or .env.example instead.
howto.when_en: Triggered when handling configuration files, environment variables, or secrets, such as setting up a new project, deployment, or refactoring config-related code.

say_en.text: Set up config hierarchy: default, env, local override.
say_en.note: Claude generates the corresponding config file structure.

say_en.text: Check my .env.example for safety, no real secrets.
say_en.note: Claude reviews the file and suggests changes.

say_en.text: Add startup validation for all required settings.
say_en.note: Claude adds validation logic to fail fast on missing settings.
